import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define necessary GSL types
class gsl_matrix(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('size1', ctypes.c_size_t),
                ('size2', ctypes.c_size_t),
                ('tda', ctypes.c_size_t),
                ('data', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
                ('block', ctypes.c_void_p),
                ('owner', ctypes.c_int)]

class gsl_vector_complex(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('size', ctypes.c_size_t),
                ('stride', ctypes.c_size_t),
                ('data', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
                ('block', ctypes.c_void_p),
                ('owner', ctypes.c_int)]

class gsl_eigen_nonsymm_workspace(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

# Function prototypes
alloc_workspace = gsl.gsl_eigen_nonsymm_alloc
alloc_workspace.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
alloc_workspace.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_eigen_nonsymm_workspace)

free_workspace = gsl.gsl_eigen_nonsymm_free
free_workspace.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_eigen_nonsymm_workspace)]

compute_eigenvalues = gsl.gsl_eigen_nonsymm
compute_eigenvalues.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix), ctypes.POINTER(gsl_vector_complex), ctypes.POINTER(gsl_eigen_nonsymm_workspace)]
compute_eigenvalues.restype = ctypes.c_int

# Helper functions
def create_gsl_matrix(matrix):
    n = len(matrix)
    flat_data = np.array(matrix, dtype=np.float64).flatten()
    data_ptr = flat_data.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))
    return gsl_matrix(n, n, n, data_ptr, None, 0)

def create_gsl_vector_complex(size):
    data = np.zeros(2 * size, dtype=np.float64)
    data_ptr = data.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))
    return gsl_vector_complex(size, 1, data_ptr, None, 0)

def compute_eigenvalues_nonsymm(matrix):
    n = len(matrix)
    gsl_mat = create_gsl_matrix(matrix)
    evals = create_gsl_vector_complex(n)
    workspace = alloc_workspace(n)
    compute_eigenvalues(ctypes.byref(gsl_mat), ctypes.byref(evals), workspace)
    free_workspace(workspace)
    return [complex(evals.data[i], evals.data[i + 1]) for i in range(0, 2 * n, 2)]

def assert_test():
    matrix = [[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]]
    eigenvalues = compute_eigenvalues_nonsymm(matrix)
    assert len(eigenvalues) == 2
    assert all(isinstance(ev, complex) for ev in eigenvalues)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    assert_test()
